scientific_gate.primary: Across the six positive drafts, compare exact target-PMID coverage in shared-first-search union candidate-follow-up results against the matched shared-first-search union static-follow-up results. Candidate must cover at least one additional positive target in aggregate and lose none of the positive target coverage in static. A target already present in shared-first search cannot earn incremental credit by reappearing in either follow-up.
non_regression: Candidate loses none of the six distinct-control own-anchor coverage in matched shared-first-search union static-follow-up results, evaluated against shared-first-search union candidate-follow-up results.
Candidate does not increase cross-pair positive-target coverage among distinct controls; deduplicate each shared-first-search union follow-up PMID set identically for both arms.
Candidate does not increase the blinded unrelated-paper fraction among returned follow-up papers; incomplete blind labels make the outcome inconclusive.
Every returned paper has complete query, selected relaxation rung, selected/fetched/final PMID, source/tool, and actual server-process provenance.
scientific_gate.shared_first_search_scoring: The identical shared-first-search set enters both arm coverage unions. Follow-up hits already present in that shared set cannot contribute an incremental gain or loss. Keep returned follow-up-paper blinded unrelated fractions as separately declared; no packet item may be missing a blind label.
scientific_gate.failure_interpretation: A primary or non-regression failure rejects this exact frozen adaptation only. It does not establish that every iterative search method fails.
scientific_gate.pass_interpretation: A pass retains the mechanism as promising only; no product adoption or release until the separately preregistered independent three-pair confirmatory comparison passes.
scientific_gate.prospective_clarification: Independent review before any study3 scientific call found that counting a follow-up re-retrieval of a seed target could fabricate incremental prior-art discovery. Union/dedup prevents this, retaining original at-least-one improvement/no-loss/control/provenance thresholds. v1/v2 remain interrupted and are not retrospectively rescored.
